# ThreadRecollection

A thread a recall found, with why it ranked where it did.

**Kind:** an object, used in responses.

## Fields

Every field is present in a response; empty ones are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `thread` | [`LoomThread`](loom-thread.md) | The thread. |
| `relevance` | `number` | Overall 0..1 ranking score. |
| `semantic` | `number` | How close the thread's meaning is to the query, 0 to 1. |
| `lexical` | `number` | How well the thread's words match the query, 0 to 1, relative to the best match. |
| `context` | `number` | 1 when the thread is about one of the people or things present, otherwise 0. |
| `companionOf` | `uuid \| null` | Set when the thread was brought back as a companion of another thread the recall found. |
